subject: Culture
title: Passover's Story
description: A micro-lesson that makes Passover's Story usable.

hook.text: Every Passover, Jewish families retell the exodus from Egypt as if they themselves just escaped.

buildup.text: The Seder meal uses symbolic foods: bitter herbs for suffering, unleavened bread for haste.

discovery.text: Passover may be the world's oldest continuously celebrated religious festival—over 3,000 years running.

twist.text: Historians debate whether the Exodus happened as described. The festival's power doesn't depend on literal truth.

climax.text: Passover teaches that freedom is never guaranteed. Each generation must remember the cost of liberty.

punchline.text: They retell the story so they never forget it.

quiz.question: What do bitter herbs symbolize at the Passover Seder?
